title: [Audit] 📊 Platform Volume & API Keys
description: The unfiltered firehose, quarantined so the forensic dashboards stay readable.

config.description: Total audited events, unfiltered. Beneath it, the distinct HTTP requests behind them — one request often emits several audit records.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `All events` = COUNT(*), requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.http.request.id) | EVAL detail = CONCAT(CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) <= 3, TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(requests), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(requests), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(requests), LENGTH(TO_STRING(requests)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(requests), 3))), " requests") | KEEP `All events`, detail

config.description: Events that survive the noise gate: what every other dashboard reads.

config.description: Successful authentication events. Elasticsearch logs one per authenticated request, so credentials making many calls generate most of them.

config.content:
Every other dashboard applies a **noise gate**; this one does not, so the whole firehose stays measurable. Every event lands in exactly one band, so the four band tiles add up to **All events** (give or take the events of the second between two tiles' fetches):
**Signal** — what the other dashboards read · **Auth success** — Elasticsearch's `authentication_success`, one per authenticated request
**Query internals** — search, `ES|QL`, Kibana `/internal/`, the suite's own traffic, `connection_granted` · **Infra health** — `cluster:monitor/main`, `elastic.maintenance`

A named API key's events carry its **creator**: a person's key counts under that person (Kind **human + key**), any other under its own name.
config.title: The quarantine dashboard
Signal vs noise over time
config.description: Audit events per time bucket, stacked by band, so the top edge is the whole firehose and Signal sits on the baseline. Hover a segment for its band and the bucket total.

config.title: Named API keys · top 12 at most (empty when none in range)
config.description: The busiest API keys that have a name, by events, as many as the panel holds. Click a key to pin it across the suite. Created by is who made the key, which Elasticsearch records on every event the key emits. A key made by a person counts under that person’s email in Highest-volume identities (Kind “human + key”); any other key has its own row there, with the same count as here. A Cloud API key has no name in the audit stream, so it is not listed here; it appears by id, as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” (its first five characters). Often empty over the default hour on a healthy project; widen the time range to see older rows.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), emails = VALUES(attributes.user.email), names = VALUES(attributes.user.name) BY attributes.api_key.name | EVAL creator = COALESCE(MV_MIN(emails), MV_MIN(names)), n_creators = COALESCE(MV_COUNT(emails), 0) + COALESCE(MV_COUNT(names), 0) | EVAL created_by = COALESCE(CONCAT(CASE((LENGTH(creator) == 20 AND creator RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT creator RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(creator, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), creator), CASE(n_creators > 1 AND emails IS NULL, CONCAT(" + ", TO_STRING(n_creators - 1), " more"), "")), " ") | KEEP attributes.api_key.name, created_by, events | SORT events DESC, attributes.api_key.name | LIMIT 12

config.title: Band share over time
config.description: Each bucket’s events as 100%, split by band. A rising Signal share means activity, not housekeeping, is driving the volume. A lull is left blank, because as a percentage a few dozen events would stand as tall as the busiest minute: a bucket under a tenth of the window’s typical (median) volume, a bucket under a third of it right beside one of those, and a lone low bar inside such a lull. A stretch that is merely quiet is drawn. Signal vs noise over time, directly above, shows every bucket’s volume.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.event.action, kib_internal = (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/cloud-audit-).*") OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((attributes.event.action == "saved_object_get" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (attributes.event.action == "saved_object_find" AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" AND (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR attributes.kibana.session.id IS NULL))) | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"), "query-noise", kib_internal, "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY ts, band | STATS total = SUM(events), parts = VALUES(CONCAT(band, "=", TO_STRING(events))) BY ts | EVAL ms = TO_LONG(ts) | STATS typical = MEDIAN(total), b = VALUES(CONCAT(TO_STRING(ms), "#", TO_STRING(total), "#", MV_CONCAT(parts, ";"))), idx = VALUES(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms), "=", TO_STRING(total))), lo = MIN(ms), hi = MAX(ms) | EVAL idx = CONCAT(MV_CONCAT(idx, ""), ";"), need = DATE_DIFF("second", TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), TO_DATETIME(?_tend)) / 75.0 | EVAL span = 1000 * TO_LONG(CASE(need <= 1, 1, need <= 5, 5, need <= 10, 10, need <= 30, 30, need <= 60, 60, need <= 300, 300, need <= 600, 600, need <= 1800, 1800, need <= 3600, 3600, need <= 10800, 10800, need <= 43200, 43200, need <= 86400, 86400, need <= 604800, 604800, need <= 2592000, 2592000, need <= 7776000, 7776000, 31536000)) | MV_EXPAND b | DISSECT b "%{ms}#%{total}#%{parts}" | EVAL ms = TO_LONG(ms), total = TO_LONG(total) | EVAL p1 = CASE(ms + -1 * span < lo OR ms + -1 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -1 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -1 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -1 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)), n1 = CASE(ms + 1 * span < lo OR ms + 1 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 1 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 1 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 1 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)), p2 = CASE(ms + -2 * span < lo OR ms + -2 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -2 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -2 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -2 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)), n2 = CASE(ms + 2 * span < lo OR ms + 2 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 2 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 2 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 2 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)), p3 = CASE(ms + -3 * span < lo OR ms + -3 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -3 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -3 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + -3 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)), n3 = CASE(ms + 3 * span < lo OR ms + 3 * span > hi, TO_LONG(-1), LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 3 * span), "=")) > 0, TO_LONG(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(idx, LOCATE(idx, CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 3 * span), "=")) + LENGTH(CONCAT(";", TO_STRING(ms + 3 * span), "="))), ";"))), TO_LONG(0)) | EVAL tp1 = p1 >= 0 AND p1 * 10 < typical, tp2 = p2 >= 0 AND p2 * 10 < typical, tp3 = p3 >= 0 AND p3 * 10 < typical, tn1 = n1 >= 0 AND n1 * 10 < typical, tn2 = n2 >= 0 AND n2 * 10 < typical, tn3 = n3 >= 0 AND n3 * 10 < typical, qp1 = p1 >= 0 AND p1 * 3 < typical, qp2 = p2 >= 0 AND p2 * 3 < typical, qn1 = n1 >= 0 AND n1 * 3 < typical, qn2 = n2 >= 0 AND n2 * 3 < typical | WHERE CASE(total * 10 < typical, false, total * 3 < typical, NOT (tp1 OR tn1 OR (qp1 AND tp2) OR (qn1 AND tn2)), total >= typical OR NOT ((p1 < 0 OR tp1 OR (qp1 AND (tp2 OR (qp2 AND tp3)))) AND (n1 < 0 OR tn1 OR (qn1 AND (tn2 OR (qn2 AND tn3)))))) | EVAL part = SPLIT(parts, ";") | MV_EXPAND part | DISSECT part "%{band}=%{events}" | EVAL `BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)` = TO_DATETIME(ms), events = TO_LONG(events) | KEEP `BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)`, band, events | EVAL ord = CASE(band == "signal", 0, band == "authn-volume", 1, band == "query-noise", 2, 3) | SORT ord | DROP ord | EVAL band = CASE(band == "signal", "Signal", band == "authn-volume", "Auth success", band == "query-noise", "Query internals", "Infra health")

config.title: Audit volume by source service
config.description: Elasticsearch versus Kibana audit volume over time. Elasticsearch audits every transport action, so it usually dwarfs Kibana.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source = resource.attributes.service.name | EVAL source = CASE(source == "serverless-elasticsearch", "Elasticsearch", source == "serverless-kibana", "Kibana", source) | SORT source

config.title: Noisiest transport actions · top 12 at most
config.description: Highest-volume Elasticsearch transport actions, unfiltered. Busiest identity is the identity behind most of each action’s events (resolved as in Highest-volume identities), followed by how many others also called it. ES|QL’s own fan-out (esql/compute, search_shards, field_caps[n]) is in Query internals, and much of it is dashboards querying this stream — often the Cloud API key running this suite, shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” (its first five characters).

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, actor | STATS events = SUM(n), actors = COUNT(*), top = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(1000000000000 + n), actor)) BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | EVAL top_identity = SUBSTRING(top, 14) | EVAL top_identity = CONCAT(CASE((LENGTH(top_identity) == 20 AND top_identity RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT top_identity RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(top_identity, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), top_identity), CASE(actors > 1, CONCAT(" + ", TO_STRING(actors - 1), " more"), "")) | KEEP attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, top_identity, events | SORT events DESC, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | LIMIT 12

config.title: Highest-volume identities · top 12 at most
config.description: Unfiltered volume leaderboard, top identities by events — this is where the machine traffic shows up (often the Cloud API key running this suite). Only the busiest rows fit, so quieter identities — including the smaller keys in Named API keys — are beyond the rows shown. Kind “API key” is a named (Elasticsearch) API key, listed under its own name, or a Cloud API key; Created by is who made a named key, which Elasticsearch records on every event the key emits. When a PERSON makes a key, its events carry that person’s email, so they count under the person, whose Kind then reads “human + key”. Kind “failed sign-in” is a username that only ever failed to authenticate — usually a guess, not an account. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), via_key = COUNT(attributes.api_key.name), creators = VALUES(attributes.user.name) WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, acts = VALUES(attributes.event.action) BY actor, actor_kind | EVAL actor_kind = CASE(actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor_kind) | EVAL actions = MV_COUNT(acts), acts = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(acts), ",") | EVAL actor_kind = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), "API key", actor_kind == "service" AND via_key == events, "API key", actor_kind == "human" AND via_key > 0, "human + key", actor_kind == "service" AND acts IN ("authentication_failed", "realm_authentication_failed", "authentication_failed,realm_authentication_failed"), "failed sign-in", actor_kind) | EVAL creator = CASE(actor_kind == "API key" AND via_key == events, MV_MIN(creators)), n_creators = MV_COUNT(creators) | EVAL created_by = COALESCE(CONCAT(CASE((LENGTH(creator) == 20 AND creator RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT creator RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(creator, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), creator), CASE(n_creators > 1, CONCAT(" + ", TO_STRING(n_creators - 1), " more"), "")), " ") | KEEP actor, actor_kind, created_by, events, actions | SORT events DESC, actor | LIMIT 12 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)
